item.title: Goodwill Industries of Hawaii to hold reuse collection event Feb. 13
item.description: LIHUE – The next reuse collection event will be held at the Kauai Resource Center (KRC) located at 3460 Ahukini Road in Lihue from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. on Feb. 13.

item.title: EDITORIAL: State must train, retain teachers
item.description: The state Department of Education’s progress in raising student learning outcomes — and in hiring, training and retaining the competent teachers necessary to do so — were scrutinized at a state Senate hearing Wednesday, bringing sticky problems to the forefront: teacher shortages, licensing backlogs and student achievement gaps, all issues of longstanding concern in Hawaii’s public schools.

item.title: Tulsi Gabbard says Trump requested her presence at FBI raid
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — U.S. Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard said on Monday she was present at last week’s FBI raid on an election facility in Georgia at the request of President Donald Trump and that her attendance was within her authority.

item.title: “INTO LIGHT Hawaii Drug Addiction: Real People, Real Stories” opens at KCCC
item.description: PUHI — The “INTO LIGHT Hawaii Drug Addiction: Real People, Real Stories” opened to an audience of more than a hundred people on Sunday in the lobby of the Kauai Community College Performing Arts Center.

item.title: High Surf Warning through Wednesday
item.description: LIHUE — The National Weather Service has issued a High Surf Warning for north- and west-facing shores of Kauai and Niihau currently in effect through 6 p.m. Wednesday. The warning may be extended, dropped or modified as conditions develop.

item.title: Finance Department, Mayor celebrate installation of DMV kiosk
item.description: HANAPEPE — Mayor Derek S.K. Kawakami and the joined the Western Motor Service ‘ohana, including the Kaiakapu family — Crystal, Koty and Jed — to celebrate the self-service motor vehicle registration kiosk that was installed at the business in December.

item.title: For those who depend on coconuts, few options exist to fight invasive beetles
item.description: Windward Oahu resident Jim Anthony credits the coconut for his ability to stay sharp at the ripe age of 91.
